answer_1.quote: In recent years, LLMs have achieved significant success in debating tasks, including argument quality assessment and debate process simulation.
answer_1.outputs: structured debate arguments with reasoning and factual support

answer_2.quote: InspireScore, a novel evaluation system that integrates both subjective and objective dimensions to enable comprehensive debate assessment

answer_3.quote: we employ a structured, prompt-based assessment across key dimensions... we design prompts to assess both sides of the debate across four dimensions.
models: LLMs used in InspireScore for subjective and objective evaluation
methods: fact extraction and verification with external evidence
logical formalization and inference using first-order logic

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators, each holding a master's degree and possessing debate experience, rate both sides of each debate across six subjective and objective dimensions, yielding 200 annotated samples.
answer_4.guideline: You will be evaluating debates conducted on 100 different topics. You are required to evaluate the performance of each side of the debate based on six specific dimensions.
